titulo.alumno:
«Рецензия на выставку»
Review of an exhibition

intro: A review combines identifiable facts, evaluation and arguments; separate which works are described from which judgement the writer makes.

piezas.titulo: A review combines identifiable facts, evaluation and arguments; separate which works are described from which judgement the writer makes.
texto: A review combines identifiable facts, evaluation and arguments; separate which works are described from which judgement the writer makes.
Adjectives such as сдержанный, выразительный or спорный steer the evaluation, but the text must explain what it rests on.

frases.estudio: Критик высоко оценил композицию выставки, но отметил нехватку пояснений к отдельным работам.
frases.alumno: The critic greatly praised the composition of the exhibition, but noted a lack of explanations for some works.

frases.estudio: По мнению автора, контраст между старой и новой живописью помогает увидеть общую тему.
frases.alumno: According to the author, the contrast between old and modern painting helps one perceive the common theme.

pregunta.texto: What aspect does the reviewer criticise?
